data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the syndicate carried opening gross claims outstanding of $701.294m (opening balance at 1 January 2018). The report records a deterioration in prior-year reserves (net) of $10.701m, driven by adverse claims development largely linked to natural catastrophe and large individual losses (notably Californian wildfires, Typhoon Jebi and the Lrssen shipyard fire). Reserve pressure was concentrated in the reinsurance and marine/hull related portfolios; specialty lines contributed positively overall. No single gross prior-year movement figure is provided in the notes, so the syndicate's reported net deterioration has been used as the quantified prior-year movement.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims Outstanding, prior-year comparative). No explicit GROSS prior-year movement line was present; note provides an explicit NET deterioration ($10,701,262) which has been used and flagged. A full gross prior-year movement was not directly stated; a gross claims development triangle exists but is complex and may be impacted by RITC/run-off entries (Motor RITC) and was not used to compute a gross PYD figure. All monetary conversions: underlying statements are in $000; amounts reported here are in millions (native currency).
